description: Live sitting/standing detection and sitting-time tracking backend: a posture state machine fed by engine frames, a tracker that accumulates sitting/standing/moving time, sitting streaks, stand reminders and Apple-Watch-like stand hours, persistent history in SQLite (stdlib sqlite3) for live data only, JSON API endpoints and provider export (CSV/JSON), plus a SYNTHETIC simulation scenario in which sitting and standing are distinguishable so the app can be demoed without hardware. Depends on FEAT-002 (backend/posture.py, calibration posture_model).
steps: Add a PostureConfig dataclass to backend/config.py and include it in AppConfig (to_dict/from_dict via _build, tolerant of older config.json files): posture_window_s=3.0 (profile averaging window), min_confidence=0.6, hold_s=5.0 (a new still posture must win this long before the state changes), transition_confirm_s=2.0 (shorter confirmation right after a movement burst), unknown_grace_s=10.0 (short unknown/no-data gaps do not break a sitting streak), away_end_streak_s=120.0, reminder_after_min=30.0 (range 1-180), stand_break_s=60.0 (upright time that counts as a stand break and clears the reminder), stand_goal_hours=12, stand_hour_min_s=60.0 (an hour counts as a stand hour with >= 1 min upright).

Extend backend/posture.py with a live `PostureClassifier`: per engine frame (hook signature hook(frame, activity), engine thread; read engine.processor.last_smoothed and engine.processor.layout like CalibrationManager._on_frame does) produce a PostureReading(ts, raw_label, state, probabilities, confidence, reason). States: 'sitting', 'standing', 'moving' (frame.motion_score >= engine.config.thresholds.movement), 'away' (empty class most likely and motion low), 'unknown' (frame.quality_ok False, motion_score None, layout mismatch with the model, or no posture model -> reason 'not calibrated'). Average the smoothed profile over posture_window_s before classify_profile. Apply hysteresis: a still posture replaces the current state only after it has had the highest probability >= min_confidence for hold_s, or transition_confirm_s if a 'moving' period ended within the last 5 s (sit-to-stand / stand-to-sit transitions produce a motion burst). Without a calibration the classifier still reports 'moving' vs 'unknown' honestly; it must never guess sitting/standing without a posture model.

Add backend/sitting.py with `SittingTracker` (pure logic, injectable clock, driven by PostureReadings with data timestamps): accumulates seconds per state per local calendar day and per hour; tracks bouts (state, start_ts, end_ts); current sitting streak (continuous sitting, tolerating unknown gaps < unknown_grace_s, ended by >= stand_break_s upright, i.e. standing or moving, or by away > away_end_streak_s); counts sit-to-stand transitions; longest sitting bout; stand hours (hours with >= stand_hour_min_s upright); reminders: when the streak reaches reminder_after_min a reminder becomes active (record a reminder event with ts), it clears when a stand break completes (record responded_after_s) and it can be snoozed via API for N minutes. 'Upright' = standing + moving (document this; Apple Watch counts moving as standing).

Add a store in backend/sitting.py (or backend/history.py) using stdlib sqlite3 at data/posture.sqlite3 (path injectable; created with tables bouts(state, start_ts, end_ts, source_kind, calibration_key) and reminders(ts, kind, streak_s, responded_after_s)); write closed bouts and checkpoint the open bout at most every 30 s; reopen safely after restart (WAL or simple transactions; one connection guarded by a lock, check_same_thread=False). ONLY persist when engine.source_kind == 'live' and not engine.synthetic; replay/simulation data is tracked in memory only and every API response carries `synthetic` / `source_kind` so the UI can label it. Add data/posture.sqlite3* to .gitignore.

Add a `PostureService` (backend/sitting.py) that registers an engine frame hook, owns the PostureClassifier, SittingTracker and store, picks up the posture model applied by CalibrationManager (FEAT-002 mechanism), and resets in-memory state when the engine source changes (engine.started_at changes). Register an engine status provider 'posture' so /api/status includes current state, confidence and streak.

Wire it in dashboard/server.py create_app (app.config['POSTURE'], data_dir/'posture.sqlite3') and add routes following the existing _json_body/_num/BadRequest patterns: GET /api/posture (current reading, state, probabilities, confidence, reason, sitting streak seconds, reminder status, calibrated flag, synthetic, source_kind), GET /api/posture/today?date=YYYY-MM-DD (totals per state, upright total, hourly 24-bin minutes per state, transitions, longest sitting bout, number of sitting bouts, average sitting bout, stand hours vs goal, reminders count and median response time), GET /api/posture/history?days=1..90 (daily totals), GET /api/posture/settings and POST /api/posture/settings (validated ranges; persist into data/config.json via the existing config_path pattern used by the detector settings route), POST /api/posture/reminder/snooze {minutes: 5-60}, GET /api/posture/export?format=csv|json&days=1..365 returning a download (Content-Disposition attachment) with a metadata header (generated time, app version, date range, calibration key, 'Research prototype, not a medical device; sitting/standing are estimated from Wi-Fi signals and may be wrong') followed by daily summaries and bouts. Validate date strings strictly.

Keep the fall-detection modules (backend/detector.py, alerts.py, monitor.py) and their routes working so existing tests pass, but they are no longer part of the product UI (FEAT-004 removes them from the page). Do not delete them.

Add a SYNTHETIC scenario to simulation/generator.py, e.g. 'desk_day' ('SYNTHETIC desk day: sitting, standing breaks, walking, away'), plus keep 'demo'. Make sitting and standing produce different static multipath in the simulator (e.g. per-posture static scatterer path-length/amplitude offsets in CSISimulator.csi for segments whose key is 'sitting' vs 'standing_still') so a calibration taken on simulation can separate them. Segment durations should be short enough for a demo (e.g. sitting bouts of ~60-90 s) and documented as synthetic. Ensure existing simulation tests still pass and add a test that a calibration run on the simulator yields a posture model whose self-check separates sitting and standing.

Tests: tests/test_sitting.py for SittingTracker with a fake clock (streak accumulation, unknown gap tolerance, stand break clears reminder, reminder fires at reminder_after_min, snooze, stand hours, day rollover at local midnight, transitions count); PostureClassifier hysteresis (no flapping on alternating noisy probabilities, faster confirmation after a movement burst, 'unknown' with reason 'not calibrated' when no model); store round-trip with tmp_path (bouts persist, reopen, today summary matches; nothing persisted for synthetic sources); API tests in tests/test_dashboard.py (or tests/test_posture_api.py) for each new route including validation errors (bad date, days out of range, bad export format, settings out of range) and that export CSV has the disclaimer header and an attachment Content-Disposition.
Run `git add -N` on every new file.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/posture returns state 'unknown' with reason 'not calibrated' before any calibration and never reports sitting/standing without a posture model

With a simulation-derived calibration applied on the desk_day scenario, GET /api/posture reports 'sitting' during sitting segments and 'standing' or 'moving' during standing/walking segments in an automated test (synthetic, labelled synthetic in the response)
SittingTracker unit tests cover streaks, reminders, snooze, stand hours and day rollover and pass
History is persisted to data/posture.sqlite3 only for live non-synthetic sources (test with a fake live engine), and survives reopening the store
GET /api/posture/export?format=csv returns an attachment with a disclaimer header; invalid parameters return HTTP 400
verification: Background smoke run: .venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599 --simulate desk_day & then curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8599/api/posture and /api/posture/today and /api/posture/export?format=csv, then kill the server
findings:
DONE. Verification: `make test` exit 0 (311 passed, 2 skipped = sklearn), compileall OK, no JS touched (dashboard/static/* unchanged). Background `python -m dashboard` launch is refused by the tool's server guard (same as FEAT-002), so the smoke run was in-process: create_app + real Engine + realtime SimulationSource('desk_day'): GET / 200; /api/posture before calibration -> unknown / 'not calibrated' / synthetic true; POST /api/simulation/calibrate 200 (~3 s); 10 s later /api/posture state 'away' (first desk_day segment is the empty room), /api/status.posture present, /api/posture/today totals, /api/posture/export?format=csv 200 attachment with disclaimer row; no sqlite rows for simulation. Non-realtime desk_day test: sitting segments 100% 'sitting', standing/walking 'standing'/'moving', empty 'away'.

FILES: new backend/sitting.py, simulation/calibration.py, tests/test_sitting.py, tests/test_posture_api.py (all git add -N). Modified backend/config.py (PostureConfig, POSTURE_RANGES, AppConfig.posture, values clamped on load), backend/posture.py (PostureClassifier, PostureReading, POSTURE_STATES, CLASS_STATES, REASON_NOT_CALIBRATED, RECENT_MOVEMENT_S=5, MOVING_CONFIRM_S=1, MIN_WINDOW_FILL=1/3), backend/calibration.py (new CalibrationManager.save_result(result, placement); save() uses it; refuses synthetic results on real sources), simulation/generator.py (desk_day, CALIBRATION_SEGMENTS, posture torso scatterer _TORSO, ROOM_SEED fixed room, person scatterers settle home in standing_still/sitting segments, CSISimulator(params, segments=None)), dashboard/server.py (routes below, _save_config helper shared with detector route), dashboard/__main__.py (closes POSTURE on exit), .gitignore (data/posture.sqlite3*), tests/test_simulation.py (SCENARIOS set now includes desk_day + 3 new tests).

DEVIATIONS / DESIGN NOTES:
- Added POST /api/simulation/calibrate (not in plan): computes a SYNTHETIC calibration offline from the scripted simulator sequence (simulation.calibration.synthetic_calibration, ~3 s), saves it to data/calibration/<placement>__classic_02514d000000_ch11-2_len128__synthetic.json and applies it. Needed because the real timed calibration cannot line up with the desk_day script; it makes the no-hardware demo show sitting/standing. 400 unless engine.source_kind == 'simulation'. The simulated room is now fixed (ROOM_SEED) so this calibration auto-loads for every later simulation run; seed only drives noise.
- Moving needs 1 s of sustained motion before it replaces a still posture (fidgeting while seated stays 'sitting'); from unknown it is immediate. A 'moving' state with no confirmed posture for hold_s + posture_window_s after motion ends decays to 'unknown'.
- Classification is 3-way (sitting/standing/empty); 'empty' maps to 'away'. probabilities keys are therefore sitting/standing/away.
- Upright = standing + moving everywhere. Sitting bouts in summaries are streaks (StreakMachine), not raw bouts. Sit-to-stand transition = a sitting bout followed (ignoring unknown and moving < 5 s) by standing, moving >= 5 s or away. Streak seconds = first to latest sitting time (freezes while standing). Stand break = continuous upright >= stand_break_s; unknown/no-data >= unknown_grace_s or away > away_end_streak_s also end a streak. Readings > 2 s apart are a data gap (unknown for streaks, no bout).
- Reminders/snooze use data timestamps (live = wall time). After a snooze expires during the same streak a new reminder fires. Streak/reminder state is in memory only (not restored after restart); bouts and reminder records persist for live data.
- Default date for today/history/export = local date of the newest reading of the current source, else today's local date.
- With no source started (source_kind null) today/history/export read the SQLite store (persisted live history); with replay/simulation they read the in-memory tracker (data_source 'memory').
- /api/posture reports state 'unknown' when the newest reading is older than 5 s wall time or the source ended (reason 'no recent data' / 'no data source'), and 'not calibrated' whenever there is no posture model (sitting/standing/away are never reported without one).

API CONTRACT FOR FEAT-004 (all JSON, Cache-Control no-store; errors are HTTP 400 {ok:false, error}):
- GET /api/posture -> {ts, raw_label (sitting|standing|moving|away|null), state (sitting|standing|moving|away|unknown), probabilities {sitting, standing, away} (empty {} when none), confidence (0-1|null), reason (str, e.g. 'not calibrated', 'posture model: sitting (p=0.97)', 'posture model: standing (p=0.9), confirming 1.2/2 s', 'motion score 7.10 >= movement threshold 6.45', 'insufficient data quality: ...', 'collecting a posture window', 'low confidence (...)', 'no recent data', 'no data source'), motion_score, state_since (data ts), state_duration_s, calibrated (bool), running (bool), data_age_s, calibration {key, name, synthetic}, streak {active, start_ts, seconds, last (last finished streak {start_ts,end_ts,duration_s,ended_by: stand_break|away|unknown, break_start_ts, ended_at_ts} | null)}, sitting_streak_s, current_bout {state,start_ts,end_ts,duration_s,start,end (ISO local),source_kind,calibration_key} | null, reminder {active, since_ts, message (e.g. 'You have been sitting for 31 min. Time to stand up and move for 1 min.' | null), reminder_after_min, due_in_s, snoozed, snoozed_until, snooze_remaining_s, stand_break_s}, today {date, totals_s{sitting,standing,moving,away,unknown}, upright_s, tracked_s, stand_hours, stand_goal_hours, transitions, sitting_bouts, longest_sitting_s}, source_kind ('live'|'replay'|'simulation'|null), synthetic (bool), persisting (bool), data_source ('store'|'memory'), states [5 states], upright_states ['standing','moving'], upright_note, disclaimer}.
- GET /api/status now has key `posture`: {state, confidence, reason, calibrated, sitting_streak_s, reminder_active, source_kind, synthetic, persisting, data_source}.
- GET /api/posture/today[?date=YYYY-MM-DD] -> {date, totals_s{5 states, seconds}, upright_s, tracked_s, hourly_min {sitting,standing,moving,away,unknown,upright: [24 floats, minutes, local hours 0-23]}, stand_hour_flags [24 bools], stand_hours, stand_goal_hours, transitions, sitting_bouts, longest_sitting_s, average_sitting_s, reminders {count, responded, median_response_s|null}, source_kind, synthetic, persisting, data_source, upright_note, disclaimer}.
- GET /api/posture/history?days=1..90 (default 7)[&end=YYYY-MM-DD] -> {days, start_date, end_date, daily: [oldest..newest {date, sitting_min, standing_min, moving_min, away_min, unknown_min, upright_min, stand_hours, stand_goal_hours, sit_to_stand_transitions, sitting_bouts, longest_sitting_min, average_sitting_min, reminders, median_reminder_response_s}], stand_goal_hours, source_kind, synthetic, persisting, data_source, upright_note, disclaimer}.
- GET /api/posture/settings -> {settings {posture_window_s 3, min_confidence 0.6, hold_s 5, transition_confirm_s 2, unknown_grace_s 10, away_end_streak_s 120, reminder_after_min 30, stand_break_s 60, stand_goal_hours 12, stand_hour_min_s 60}, ranges {name: {min, max}} (posture_window_s 1-10, min_confidence 0.5-0.99, hold_s 1-60, transition_confirm_s 0.5-30 and <= hold_s, unknown_grace_s 0-300, away_end_streak_s 10-3600, reminder_after_min 1-180, stand_break_s 10-600, stand_goal_hours 1-24 integer, stand_hour_min_s 10-1800), upright_note, disclaimer}.
- POST /api/posture/settings {any subset of settings} -> {ok, saved_to (config path or null), settings, ranges, upright_note, disclaimer}; unknown key / out of range / non-number / null / bool / non-integer goal -> 400. Applied immediately; saved to data/config.json under 'posture'.
- POST /api/posture/reminder/snooze {minutes: 5-60, default 10} -> {ok, reminder (same shape as /api/posture reminder)}.
- GET /api/posture/export?format=csv|json (default csv)&days=1..365 (default 30)[&end=YYYY-MM-DD] -> download, Content-Disposition attachment; filename="posture_<start>_<end>[_SYNTHETIC].csv|json". CSV: '# key,value' rows (title, generated, app_version, date_range 'A to B', calibration_key, source, upright, stand_hour_rule, disclaimer), blank, '# daily summary', header + daily rows (same columns as history daily), blank, '# bouts', header state,start,end,duration_s,source_kind,calibration_key. JSON: {metadata {title, generated, app_version, date_range [a,b], calibration_key, calibration_keys_in_data, source, source_kind, synthetic, upright, stand_hour_rule, disclaimer}, daily [...], bouts [Bout.to_dict], reminders [{id, ts, kind reminder|snooze, streak_s, responded_after_s, ...}]}. UI can link directly (an <a href> download works under the CSP).
- POST /api/simulation/calibrate {placement?: str, default 'simulated-room'} -> {ok, key, path, calibration (summary), synthetic: true, posture_self_check {per_class, accuracy, blocks, chance_accuracy}, notice}; 400 when the source is not the simulation.
- GET /api/simulation scenarios now include desk_day ('SYNTHETIC desk day: sitting, standing breaks, walking, away'; ~304 s cycle: away 20, walking in 8, standing 12, sit down, sitting 75, stand up, standing break 30, walking 20, standing 15, sit down, sitting 90, stand up, walking out 8, away 20). Start it with POST /api/source {kind:'simulation', scenario:'desk_day'} or `make dashboard-sim SCENARIO=desk_day` / `python -m dashboard --simulate desk_day`. Demo flow: start desk_day, POST /api/simulation/calibrate, then poll /api/posture (about 1 Hz) and /api/posture/today (every few s). To show a reminder in a demo set reminder_after_min to 1 via settings.
